lost_account.title: Lost account
lost_account.at_risk: pre-loss monthly level x window months x price (revenue missed if the account returns)

window_event.title: Event in the forecast window
window_event.at_risk: latent demand the event multiplier removes x price

recent_switch.title: Recent customer switch
recent_switch.at_risk: |post - pre switch level| x window months x price

cold_start.title: Cold start (planned launch)
cold_start.at_risk: whole forecast revenue of the series (prior-based)

end_of_life.title: End of life in the window
end_of_life.at_risk: forecast revenue of the phase-out months (run-off timing)

backtest_bias.title: Backtest bias beyond ±10 %
backtest_bias.at_risk: |bias| x 19-month forecast revenue of the segment

history_quality.title: Imputed recent history
history_quality.at_risk: forecast revenue x share of the last 24 months imputed
